caption: As it opens under the row's Mark paid: the person and the amount, Paid by preset to the family's choice with the hint “They chose Check on the form.”, and Mark paid $50, which has the first focus (nothing is lost, so Enter does the usual thing). Esc or a click outside closes it.

They pay another way: one tap on Card — no trip to ⋯ Change how they'll pay first. The hint still says what they chose on the form; the button keeps the amount. The section is told the chosen method and saves it (its own toast, as today).

Camps opens the same box from its “Owes $15.50” tag, as today (v1.001: tag → box). The amount is what the section gives — here what a camper still owes, with cents written as the money rule says (“$15.50”, v1.026). The box never lets the amount be typed.

No choice on record (e.g. added at the desk without one): nothing is preset, there's no hint, and Mark paid $50 stays gray (the approved unavailable look, still focusable) with the gray line “Choose how they paid.” until one is picked. Here the first focus goes on Cash, the first choice.
